description: External assets this repository deliberately does not keep in git: the Yaskawa GP7/GP8 documents and the upstream ROS-Industrial GP8 robot model. Fetched from their own source URLs by tools/fetch_external_assets.py.

groups.name: documents
groups.description: Yaskawa GP7/GP8 datasheets and manuals - the paper the real robot parameters come from.

assets.why: GP7/GP8 datasheet: the source of the specification table the solver is built on - payload 8 kg, reach 727 mm, repeatability +/-0.02 mm, robot mass 32 kg in the GP8 column (the 34 kg on the same row is the GP7), per-axis ranges and maximum speeds, allowable wrist moments R/B/T 17/17/10 N m and allowable wrist moments of inertia R/B/T 0.5/0.5/0.2 kg m^2; one of the two revisions kept side by side.
assets.licence: Specification document (C) Yaskawa America Inc., Motoman Robotics Division. Redistributed by nobody: this repository stores no copy and claims no rights - the file is fetched at init time from the host's own public URL. This copy is served by the distributor Logic Control (cdn.logic-control.com).

assets.why: The publisher's own copy of the same GP7/GP8 datasheet. Both revisions are kept because they are two revisions of one document: holding them side by side is what lets a changed specification number be seen rather than assumed.
assets.licence: Specification document (C) Yaskawa America Inc., Motoman Robotics Division. Redistributed by nobody: this repository stores no copy and claims no rights - the file is fetched at init time from the host's own public URL. This copy is served by the publisher itself (www.motoman.com).

assets.why: Yaskawa manual HW1484385, MOTOMAN-GP8/-GP7 Supplemental Instructions: the model-specific addendum to the general instruction manual (axis designations, installation and wiring detail for this exact model).
assets.licence: Specification document (C) Yaskawa America Inc., Motoman Robotics Division. Redistributed by nobody: this repository stores no copy and claims no rights - the file is fetched at init time from the host's own public URL. This copy is served from the Cloudinary bucket of a Yaskawa reseller's document portal.

assets.why: Yaskawa manual HW1483944, MOTOMAN-GP8/AR700 and -GP7/AR900 Instructions: the full manipulator manual - transport, installation, wiring, maintenance and the dimensional and working-envelope drawings.
